scope: Two new downloaded photographs, directly visually inspected and decoded. Both CC BY 2.0 rights pages record reviewed Flickr licensing. Neither is an R7 archive shot. Not a release approval of the finished documentary.
global_usage_notes: Each photograph is identified by its creator, original source, license, date and filming context. These credits accompany the downloadable documentary.
The photographs show a UCL research cleanroom and Intel D1X construction. Neither is presented as a TSMC production facility.
Copyright licenses do not imply endorsement or remove personality/trademark rights.
Original JPEG bytes are preserved. The edit applies a 16:9 crop, display scaling, slow crop zoom and source/title overlays; no generative image edits.
The 3D spaces are explanatory reconstructions based on public evidence, not footage or surveyed models of a named factory. Manufacturer videos were used for research and are not redistributed here.
